articles.summary: KALISPELL, Mont., March 25, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Glacier Bancorp, Inc.'s (NYSE: GBCI) Board of Directors, at a meeting held on March 25, 2026, declared a quarterly dividend of $0.33 per share. The Company has declared 164 consecutive quarterly dividends and has increased the dividend 49 times.
articles.title: Glacier Bancorp, Inc. Declares Quarterly Dividend
